cause_quote: The first PostgreSQL model-context reader used `jsonPathValue` on stored transcript text, and its new `${value}::jsonb` cast rejected unpaired surrogate and NUL escapes.
user_saw: In PostgreSQL-backed sessions, follow-up turns failed after a transcript entry with an unpaired surrogate, and user messages containing NUL were dropped.
summary: The fix decodes transcript rows in JavaScript when PostgreSQL cannot cast them to JSONB and replaces NUL with spaces only in derived search text.
reasoning: I checked the PostgreSQL reader port and its predecessor. The port added the PostgreSQL model-context branch with a JSONB cast on stored text, while the preceding projection used SQLite JSON functions. The later PostgreSQL optimization retained the same cast, and the separate full-text indexing port in #173462 bound message text directly into the PostgreSQL text column, causing the NUL write failure.
